import pandas as pd

def explain_one(payload, k=2):
    prep = model.named_steps["prep"]
    lr = model.named_steps["model"]
    x=prep.transform(pd.DataFrame([payload]))
    if hasattr(x,'toarray'):x=x.toarray()
    scores=np.asarray(x).ravel()*lr.coef_[0]
    names=prep.get_feature_names_out()
    return [names[i].split('__',1)[-1] for i in np.argsort(-scores) if scores[i]>0][:k]

def order_features(cutoff):

    act = active_at(c).set_index("client_id")

    last=hist.groupby('client_id').order_date.max().reindex(f.index).fillna(act.start_date)
